title: test(dogfood): pin five records-forms checklist items at the REST door (slice 1)
body:

_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8EZuqRp2sWT5mEbwB3fUdmh)_

Refs #26573 (slice 1 of about 5 items: `predicate-relationship-traversal`, `write-answer-advisories-rollback-and-tree-delete`, `comment-reactions-and-edit-stamps`, `encrypted-field-behavior`, `write-time-option-and-element-shape-judgement`)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：records-forms 区 5 个清单项的 api 条款原先只有引擎层/进程内的钉测，现在新增 5 个 dogfood 测试文件，在真实启动的栈上经 REST 门断言这些条款，并把 5 项的 `automated.ref` 改为指向新钉测（revision 各加 1，history 引本卡）。
- 为什么改：18.2.0 Tier 1 扫描把这些条款判为 PARTIAL（钉测低于条款 oracle 的层）；按维护者「同意」的分卡，每次发版都要补跑活腿，钉在 oracle 层之后就是常驻可复跑的证据。
- 风险与回滚：只加测试和清单文字，不动产品代码、不加 CI 车道；新文件跑在现有 dogfood 腿里（isolated 项目）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/qa/dogfood/test/encrypted-field-behavior.dogfood.test.ts`（无加密提供者的 fail-closed 腿是启动后把引擎的 provider 置空，看这个建模是否可接受）；`packages/qa/dogfood/test/comment-reactions-and-edit-stamps.dogfood.test.ts`（实测码 405 / 403）；`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json` 的 5 处 `automated` 与 history。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/predicate-relationship-traversal.dogfood.test.ts test/write-answer-warnings-rest.dogfood.test.ts test/comment-reactions-and-edit-stamps.dogfood.test.ts test/encrypted-field-behavior.dogfood.test.ts test/write-time-option-and-element-shape.dogfood.test.ts`（先建依赖闭包），预期 5 个文件 22 个用例全绿；`node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` 预期 OK。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Five new dogfood files, each booting a real stack through `@objectstack/verify` and driving the REST doors (`/data/:object`, `/data/:object/query`, `/data/:object/import`), so these api clauses are pinned at the layer their oracle names:

| Item (rev → new) | Clauses now pinned over REST | Pin |
|---|---|---|
| `predicate-relationship-traversal` (4 → 5) | acceptance[0]–[3], negative[0]–[2] | `predicate-relationship-traversal.dogfood.test.ts` — the showcase invoice rule as shipped, plus the scratch pair `fixtures.knownGaps` describes for a member with no parent grant |
| `write-answer-advisories-rollback-and-tree-delete` (2 → 3) | acceptance[1]; acceptance[2] and negative[0] | `write-answer-warnings-rest.dogfood.test.ts` (new) reads the PATCH body's `warnings[]`; the existing `hook-after-abort-rollback.dogfood.test.ts` already refused the aborting create over REST and read the store back, and is now named |
| `comment-reactions-and-edit-stamps` (3 → 4) | acceptance[1]–[3] | `comment-reactions-and-edit-stamps.dogfood.test.ts` — org-bound comments fixture + plugin-audit, the member armed (`assertArmed`) as `org_member` |
| `encrypted-field-behavior` (5 → 6) | acceptance[2]–[4], negative[1]–[3] | `encrypted-field-behavior.dogfood.test.ts` — showcase field zoo for the echoed mask and the aggregate refusal; a scratch object on an engine left with no crypto provider for fail-closed |
| `write-time-option-and-element-shape-judgement` (1 → 2) | acceptance[1]–[4] | `write-time-option-and-element-shape.dogfood.test.ts` — scratch app: faulting option gate, kept-option import, matched-row dry run, multi-lookup element shape |

Each item's `automated.ref` names the new pin and what it scores; the existing engine/unit pins stay named as acceptance[0]'s pins and as evidence of their own layer (RUNNER rule 6). One history row per item, citing #26573. No clause text, fixture, step or `knownGaps` line was edited (the claim's file surface).

Left out of this slice: `record-discussion-mentions` a9 (needs the #26625 walled two-organization recipe) and the browser/dom-oracle items, which need Playwright or live-boot specs.

## Why

The 18.2.0 release-candidate Tier 1 run scored these clauses PARTIAL: every pin was green, but each asserted the clause below its oracle's layer (in-process protocol calls, ObjectQL directly, or an ObjectKernel with no HTTP adapter). A pin at the oracle's layer turns a release-sweep live leg into a standing, re-runnable proof. The triage ruling allows ~5-item slices and no new CI lane; the new files fall under the dogfood package's existing `isolated` vitest project and run where the dogfood legs run today.

## Tests

Measured answers the pins now hold (all first read live, then pinned exactly):

- reaction PATCH → `405 OBJECT_API_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED` (the object's `apiMethods` offers no update); foreign reaction DELETE → `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` with the member holding the object delete bit, so the refusal is the own-record floor; own DELETE is the 2xx control.
- the warning-rule PATCH → `200` with `warnings: [{ rule: project_health_progression, severity: warning, field: health, code: invalid_transition, message }]`; one-step change and the create answer carry no `warnings` key.
- faulting option → `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, `tier` / `rule_violation`, `constraint.rule: visibleWhen`, `constraint.reason: unevaluable`.
- multi-lookup elements `{id}`, `false`, `42` → `400` `refs` / `invalid_type`, `constraint.detail` starting `at index 1:`.
- credential group-by / MIN / MAX over `POST /data/showcase_field_zoo/query` → `400 INVALID_FIELD`; a group-by on `name` is the `200` control.
- fail-closed secret POST → `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` and no row stored; a password write on the same engine → `201`, masked on read.

<details><summary>Runs</summary>

- Dependency closure: `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/dogfood^...' --concurrency=2` under `os-verify-lock.sh` → `Tasks: 67 successful, 67 total`, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- First run (pre-merge head): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over the five files → `Test Files 5 passed (5)`, `Tests 22 passed (22)`.
- After merging `origin/main` (head `8919aecc`, which brought a driver-sql refactor): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql build`, then the five files plus `hook-after-abort-rollback.dogfood.test.ts` → `Test Files 6 passed (6)`, `Tests 28 passed (28)`, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`) → VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Final head `5db5a474` (after merging `origin/main` with #26337): the dependency closure rebuilt (`Tasks: 67 successful, 67 total`), then the five files plus `hook-after-abort-rollback.dogfood.test.ts` → `Test Files 6 passed (6)`, `Tests 28 passed (28)`, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood typecheck`, one locked command, VERDICT command-exit 0.

</details>

No ablation was run: this diff adds tests and changes no behaviour they pin (os-dev: ablation only where the diff changes a pinned behaviour). Each refusal assertion has a same-door admitted control beside it, so none passes on a door that refuses everything.

## Acceptance notes

- `encrypted-field-behavior` acceptance[3]: `bootStack` always wires a crypto provider, so the fail-closed leg unsets it once after bootstrap (`engine.setCryptoProvider(undefined)`), before any request. That is the engine state of a boot that never wired one; no stock composition boots that way, so on a live stock boot the clause stays blocked(fixture). `fixtures.knownGaps[1]` still says the path has "NO live leg"; it is still true of a live boot, and its rewording is left to an item-text pass since this slice's surface is `automated.ref` / `revision` / `history` only. The refusal arrives as the sanitised `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`, because the engine throws a plain `Error`: noted, not filed, since an unwired provider is a host composition fault, not an author error.
- `predicate-relationship-traversal` acceptance[3]: now scored live on the scratch substitute the item's `fixtures.knownGaps` already prescribes, rather than only from the engine pin.
- `write-answer-advisories…` acceptance[2] / negative[0] were already pinned over REST by `hook-after-abort-rollback.dogfood.test.ts` (it reads the store back through the engine rather than a list count); revision 2 did not name it.

## Verification

- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` → exit 0, `OK — 16 areas, 329 items (324 active, 1 planned)`.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` → 55 commands on head `8919aecc`, each run and reconciled with `--ran`: `55 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 54 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED`. The NOT-MEASURED one is `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it reads every package's `dist/` and this worktree built only the dogfood closure); CI runs it. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first exited 3 on the shallow clone and is exit 0 after `git fetch --unshallow`.
- After merging `origin/main` again (it brought #26337, which touches `coverage.json` and `packages/qa/dogfood/test`): `check-platform-checklist` exit 0 on the new head; the five files are re-run there (see Runs).
- CI families are read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run locally.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (CI-owned run)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset — nothing publishes here (`@objectstack/dogfood` is private; `docs/qa/**` ships in no package), so `skip-changeset`; both declaration lines are filled in above.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the maintainer brief above is Chinese by the repo's communication rule).
